image_purpose: Introduces the environment-matching game, showing a stylized 'world' of different biomes.

scene_logic.composition: A high-angle, 'pop-up book' view of a vibrant prehistoric island. The island is divided into three clear zones: a steamy volcanic lagoon (Hell Creek style), a dry sandy desert with scrub (Djadokhta style), and a lush, misty conifer forest (Morrison style).
scene_logic.primary_character: In the center foreground, a friendly, brightly-colored Edmontosaurus stands holding a large, rolled-up stone 'map'. It is looking at the player with an inviting smile.
scene_logic.interactive_element: Floating above each biome is a semi-transparent, glowing 'empty' slot shaped like a dinosaur footprint, suggesting where the player needs to place the right friend.
scene_logic.perspective: A slightly tilted, 'god-view' perspective that makes the world look like a playable toy set.

main_title.style: Extra-thick 3D red block letters with a glossy 'candy' finish.
main_title.color: Bright Red with a white outline.
main_title.placement: Top center, following a slight curve.

character_details.expressions: The Edmontosaurus looks like a helpful guide. Big, sparkling eyes and a cheerful, open posture. No 'wild' or aggressive traits.
character_details.texture: Clean, satin-finished clay style. Soft peach and sunset-orange color patterns on its back.
character_details.finish: Octane render quality with high-poly smoothness.

environmental_details.lighting: Bright, multi-directional 'studio' lighting to make each zone pop. Vibrant saturations: deep emeralds, fiery oranges, and golden sands.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Cheerful, organized, and adventurous. Clean air with tiny floating 'magic' sparkles over the biomes.
environmental_details.ground: Clearly defined textures: 'Dark rich organic mud' for the lagoon, 'Dry sandy soil' for the desert, and 'Lush green moss' for the forest.

negative_prompt: messy, realistic, scary, humans, text errors, blurry, flat 2D, dark, muddy colors, 90s CGI, 'Habitats' misspelled
